Flexbox Playground

Interactive flexbox container builder.


    

    

      
    

  





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Choose flex-direction, flex-wrap and the alignment properties.
  2. Drag the gap slider to space the items.
  3. Set how many demo items to show (1–12).
  4. Copy the generated container CSS into your stylesheet.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What is the difference between justify-content and align-items?
justify-content aligns items along the main axis (horizontal in a row), while align-items aligns them along the cross axis (vertical in a row).
How do I make items wrap to a new line?
flex-wrap: wrap lets items flow onto multiple lines; align-content then controls how those lines are spaced.
Can I test with many items?
Yes — set the item count up to 12 and toggle flex-wrap to see wrapping in action.
